title: Can you calculate the 5-day symmetric moving average of predicted toy sales
question: Can you calculate the 5-day symmetric moving average of predicted toy sales for December 5 to 8, 2018, using daily sales data from January 1, 2017, to August 29, 2018, with a simple linear regression model? Finally provide the sum of those four 5-day moving averages?

prediction.sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS d,
         SUM(oi.price) AS sales
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name = 'brinquedos'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-08-30'
  GROUP BY DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
n AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
         SUM(CAST(julianday(d) AS REAL)) AS sx,
         SUM(sales) AS sy,
         SUM(CAST(julianday(d) AS REAL)*sales) AS sxy,
         SUM(CAST(julianday(d) AS REAL)*CAST(julianday(d) AS REAL)) AS sxx
  FROM daily
),
params AS (
  SELECT (sxy - sx*sy/n) / (sxx - sx*sx/n) AS slope,
         sy/n - (sxy - sx*sy/n)/(sxx - sx*sx/n)*sx/n AS intercept
  FROM n
),
pred AS (
  SELECT DATE('2018-12-05') AS d,
         slope*CAST(julianday('2018-12-05') AS REAL) + intercept AS y
  FROM params
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE('2018-12-06'), slope*CAST(julianday('2018-12-06') AS REAL) + intercept FROM params
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE('2018-12-07'), slope*CAST(julianday('2018-12-07') AS REAL) + intercept FROM params
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE('2018-12-08'), slope*CAST(julianday('2018-12-08') AS REAL) + intercept FROM params
),
ma AS (
  SELECT p.d,
         AVG(q.y) AS ma5
  FROM pred p
  JOIN pred q
    ON q.d BETWEEN DATE(p.d, '-2 day') AND DATE(p.d, '+2 day')
  GROUP BY p.d
)
SELECT SUM(ma5) AS sum_ma5
FROM ma

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT date(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS d,
         SUM(oi.price) AS sales
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name = 'brinquedos'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-08-30'
  GROUP BY date(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
n AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
             SUM(d) AS sx,
             SUM(sales) AS sy,
             SUM(d*d) AS sxx,
             SUM(d*sales) AS sxy
      FROM daily)
SELECT SUM(
  ( (n.sxy - n.sx*n.sy/n.n) / (n.sxx - n.sx*n.sx/n.n) ) * t
  + ( n.sy/n.n - (n.sxy - n.sx*n.sy/n.n)/(n.sxx - n.sx*n.sx/n.n) * n.sx/n.n )
) AS total
FROM n
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT 20181205 AS t UNION ALL SELECT 20181206 UNION ALL SELECT 20181207 UNION ALL SELECT 20181208
) t;
